bathymetry.npz.dataset: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model (v1, surface elevation, EGM2008 heights)
bathymetry.npz.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
bathymetry.npz.access: OPeNDAP subset of tile N30W090, native resolution, no resampling
bathymetry.npz.license: U.S. Government work, public domain (NOAA/NCEI); please credit NOAA NCEI
bathymetry.npz.resolution: 15 arc-seconds (~0.004167 deg, ~460 m) ; grid 720 rows x 799 cols, cell-centred

arrays.elevation_m: float32 [lat, lon], metres, positive up, negative below sea level; row 0 = NORTH edge, col 0 = WEST edge

bathymetry.npz.notes: Land heights come from a surface model (includes buildings/canopy), so max ~214 m over Miami is not terrain.

surface_currents.npz.dataset: HYCOM ESPC-D-V02 Global 1/12 deg Analysis (HYCOM 2.2.99 + NCODA, expt_03.1), FMRC Best Time Series, surface (depth 0 m) water_u / water_v
surface_currents.npz.provider: U.S. Navy FNMOC / NRL, distributed by HYCOM.org
surface_currents.npz.license: Approved for public release; distribution unlimited (U.S. Government); credit HYCOM.org / U.S. Navy
surface_currents.npz.data_timestamp: 2026-11-16T12:00:00Z (analysis/nowcast hour 0 of the 2026-11-16T12Z run; newest run available on 2026-11-19)
surface_currents.npz.resolution: 0.08 deg longitude x 0.04 deg latitude (GLBy0.08 grid, ~8 km x 4.5 km); grid 86 rows x 47 cols, lat 27.52..24.12, lon -81.20..-77.52
surface_currents.npz.notes: NaN = model land (HYCOM also masks parts of the very shallow Bahama Banks / Andros). Model output, not a direct observation. NOAA CoastWatch blended NRT currents (noaacwBLENDEDNRTcurrentsDaily) is not served by coastwatch.pfeg ERDDAP (404); HYCOM is finer than OSCAR (1/3 deg) anyway.

virginia_key_snapshot.json.dataset: NOAA CO-OPS station 8723214 Virginia Key, FL: water_level (MLLW), wind, air_temperature, water_temperature, air_pressure (6-minute, preliminary)
virginia_key_snapshot.json.provider: NOAA National Ocean Service, Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS)
virginia_key_snapshot.json.url: https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter (station=8723214, units=metric, time_zone=gmt, format=json, application=gulf_stream_neon; begin/end for last 24 h and date=latest per product; exact URLs stored per request in the file)
virginia_key_snapshot.json.license: U.S. Government work, public domain (NOAA); preliminary data subject to revision
virginia_key_snapshot.json.resolution: 6-minute samples (240 per product over 24 h); station at 25.7314 N, -80.1618 E
